title: Movement or shift?

predict.q: The central bank raises its interest rate. The price level has not changed. What happens on the AD diagram?

options.fb: Dearer borrowing cuts consumption and investment at every price level, so the whole AD curve shifts left.

The interest rate effect along AD happens when the price level changes and pushes interest rates up. Here the central bank changed the rate, with no change in the price level, so the whole curve moves.
Savers do earn more, but dearer borrowing cuts C and I, and saving becomes more attractive than spending: AD falls.

options.s: Nothing: interest rates only affect banks
options.fb: Households and firms borrow from banks, so a higher rate reaches their spending: AD shifts left.

task: Move the **price level** slider and watch the point slide along AD. Then move the **interest rate** slider and watch the whole curve move.

target.do: Raise the interest rate (price level at 100), then press Check.

takeaway: The price level moves the economy **along** AD; a change in the interest rate set by the central bank **shifts** AD.
